metadata.name: UpdateCardDetail
metadata.description: Use this API to update cardholder's PII (personal identification information), address information, and additional information (if applicable).

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: ClientID
request_fields.description: Client Id Valid Values: 1422245 Format:1089 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example: 123456******0001. Condition: At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number/Account Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition:At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number/Account Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: Title
request_fields.description: Title for the customer can be set by this tag. Valid Values: Refer Appendix section :  Title Values Example: Mr. , Mrs, Dr. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: Cardholder First Name Valid values : A-Z, a-z and Spaces Example: Andrew Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: MiddleName
request_fields.description: Cardholder Middle Name Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,special characters ( !@#$%^*()_+=-.) and Ampersand Example: Charles Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Cardholder Last Name Valid values : A-Z, a-z and Spaces Example: Hudson Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SecondLastName
request_fields.description: Second Last Name Valid values are A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Andrew Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: NameOnCard
request_fields.description: Name to be Embossed on Card Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, and all special characters Example: Hudson M Charles Allowable Values: 28

request_fields.name: DateOfBirth
request_fields.description: Date of Birth of cardholder Format: MM/DD/YYYY Valid Values: 0-9 Example:- 03/26/1986

request_fields.name: MotherMaidenName
request_fields.description: Mother’s Maiden Name Valid Values: A-Z,a-z Example: Devi Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: SocialSecurityNumber
request_fields.description: Social Security Number of Card Holder Valid Value:0-9 Ex: 123456789 Condition:At least one of SocialSecurityNumber, TaxID or IDName field should be passed in the input as Identification details Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: IDName
request_fields.description: ID Code representing Name of ID Valid Values: 0-9 Example 05 Condition:At least one of SocialSecurityNumber, TaxID or IDName field should be passed in the input as Identification details Refer Appendix section :  ID Name Values Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: IDNumber
request_fields.description: Last 4 Digits of Primary ID Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 4586 Allowable Values: 18

request_fields.name: IDDescription
request_fields.description: ID Description. Valid Values: A-Z,a-z, 0-9. Condition:ID Description Field will be ignored in case of ID Name other than '13 - Other ID'. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: IDIssueCountry
request_fields.description: ID Issuing Country Valid values :A-Z, a-z Example: US Two Character Country Code should be passed in the request and not Country Name. Condition : This field is mandatory when IDName= "02","03", "04","05", "06", "07", "08", "09", "10", “11”, "12", "13". Please refer to Appendix Country Code Values Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: IDIssueState
request_fields.description: ID Issue State. Valid Values: A-Z,a-z Example:GA Condition:This field is mandatory when IDName= "02", "07" and IDIssueCountry = USMobilePhoneNumber. Appendix Section: Refer Appendix Section : State Codes (US) Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: IDIssueDate
request_fields.description: ID  Issue Date Format: MM/DD/YYYY Valid Values:0-9 Example: 03/26/1998 Condition: This field is mandatory when IDName= "02"

request_fields.name: IDExpirationDate
request_fields.description: Expiration date of ID. Format: MM/DD/YYYY Valid Values:0-9 Example:12/12/2015 Condition:At least one of Id Name should be required.

request_fields.name: CustomAccountID
request_fields.description: Any custom ID which is used to uniquely identify the Account. Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example:123456789 Condition: Mandatory If Custom Account ID  on product as Enabled. Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: AddressLine1
request_fields.description: Address Line 1 of a Cardholder Valid values are A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 15 Penang Street Point Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AddressLine2
request_fields.description: Address Line 2 of a Cardholder Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 15 Penang Street Point Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: Country
request_fields.description: Two Character Country Code. Valid values :A-Z, a-z Example: US Refer Appendix section : Country Code Values Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: State
request_fields.description: Cardholder State of residencex Valid values are A-Z, a-z Example: GA Please refer Appendix Section : State Codes (US) Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: City
request_fields.description: Cardholder's City of residence Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Norcross Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: PostalCode
request_fields.description: Cardholder Postal Code of Residence Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: 30093 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: HomePhoneCountryCode
request_fields.description: Home Phone Country Code. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 91 Refer Appendix section : Phone Country Code Values

request_fields.name: HomePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Home Phone Number. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 9812338769 Condition: Mandatory when Card Account Parameters on Product is Set as Yes. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: HomePhoneExtension
request_fields.description: Home Phone Number Extension Valid Values:0-9 Example:91

request_fields.name: WorkPhoneCountryCode
request_fields.description: Cardholder's work phone country code. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 91

request_fields.name: WorkPhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Cardholder  Work Phone Number Valid values:0-9 Example:9632581470 Condition:Mandatory when validation parameter set on product as WorkPhone. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: WorkPhoneExtension
request_fields.description: Cardholder's work phone extension code. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 1589

request_fields.name: MobilePhoneCountryCode
request_fields.description: Cardholder's Mobile Phone Country Code. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 91

request_fields.name: FaxNumberCountryCode
request_fields.description: Country code of Fax number. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: 12 Example: 20

request_fields.name: WorkFaxCountryCode
request_fields.description: Country code of WorkFax number. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: 12 Example: 20

request_fields.name: MobilePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Cardholder's Mobile Phone Number Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 9876543210 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: HomeFaxNumber
request_fields.description: Cardholder Home Fax Number Valid values are 0-9 Example:9632581470 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: WorkFaxNumber
request_fields.description: Cardholder's Work Fax Number Valid values: 0-9 Example:9632581470 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: EmailAddress1
request_fields.description: E Mail Address 1 of Cardholder Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9. Example: [email protected] Condition: If the validation parameter is set on the product for Primary Email Address then it will be mandatory. Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: EmailAddress2
request_fields.description: E Mail Address 2 of Card holder Ex: [email protected] Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: NoteReason
request_fields.description: Flag for Predefined Memo Reasons. Please refer appendix Section : Memo Reason. Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: NotesText
request_fields.description: Notes entered by the user Valid Values : A-Z,0-9 Example : Card found. Allowable Values: 2000

request_fields.name: AlertEmailAddress
request_fields.description: Email address of the cardholder where alert should be sent. Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9. Example: [email protected] Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: UserField1
request_fields.description: Account level Field to capture additional data from cardholder as per product setup. Format in case of date: MMDDYYYY Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: Test,1234,09102019 Allowable Values: 200

request_fields.name: UserField2
request_fields.description: Account level Field to capture additional data from cardholder as per product setup. Format in case of date: MMDDYYYY Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: Test,1234,09102019 Allowable Values: 200

request_fields.name: UserField3
request_fields.description: Account level Field to capture additional data from cardholder as per product setup. Format in case of date: MMDDYYYY Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: Test,1234,09102019 Allowable Values: 200

request_fields.name: UserField4
request_fields.description: Account level Field to capture additional data from cardholder as per product setup. Format in case of date: MMDDYYYY Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: Test,1234,09102019 Allowable Values: 200

request_fields.name: UserField5
request_fields.description: Account level Field to capture additional data from cardholder as per product setup. Format in case of date: MMDDYYYY Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: Test,1234,09102019 Allowable Values: 200

request_fields.name: ImmediatePostACH
request_fields.description: Flag to indicate the posting of Future dated ACH Transaction will be done on effective date. Valid Value: - 1= Not Allowed, 2 = All Credits and 3= Credits – Payroll Example:- 1

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account Number of the cardholder. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 2000000000000396893
